## Kling 2.5 Turbo Pro API

Kling 2.5 Turbo Pro is a text to video and image to video model by Kling AI, available on the Venice API as `kling-2.5-turbo-pro-text-to-video`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Kling 2.5 Turbo Pro is Kling AI's full-quality Kling 2.5 video model, generating 5- or 10-second clips from text.

### Kling 2.5 Turbo Pro API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kling-2.5-turbo-pro-text-to-video` | Text to video | Anonymized | from $0.0775 / sec |
| `kling-2.5-turbo-pro-image-to-video` | Image to video | Anonymized | from $0.0775 / sec |

### Kling 2.5 Turbo Pro specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Kling AI |
| Released | Sep 25, 2025 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Modes | text to video and image to video |
| Durations | 5s, 10s |
| Aspect ratios | 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 |
| Audio | None |

### How to use the Kling 2.5 Turbo Pro API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` with `"model": "kling-2.5-turbo-pro-text-to-video"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "kling-2.5-turbo-pro-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "kling-2.5-turbo-pro-text-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
